name: Nasdaq symbol directory
coverage: US Nasdaq and other US exchange listings
fields: Symbol; security name; market category; ETF flag; test issue; financial status
extraction_method: Delimited files; field definitions on page
historical_availability: Current master; archive snapshots yourself, not a historical delisting database
extraction_outcome: Official documentation reviewed; file ingestion not implemented
commercial_redistribution: Public access established; commercial redistribution permission not established for the directory. Confirm in writing before sale.
coverage_gaps: No OHLCV; no worldwide master; symbol changes need temporal identifiers.

name: Alpha Vantage equity and calendar endpoints
coverage: Selected global securities; exact symbol and endpoint coverage require validation
fields: Daily date/open/high/low/close/volume; dividend/split; company overview; IPO/earnings calendar; gainers/losers
historical_availability: Daily history advertised as 20+ years; plan and symbol dependent
extraction_outcome: Documentation and terms reviewed; no authenticated extraction performed
commercial_redistribution: Default terms are personal/noncommercial; written commercial agreement required. A paid key alone is not resale permission.
coverage_gaps: Public API candidate, not open licensed source; calendar completeness and adjustment method need tests.

name: Nasdaq Daily List
fields: New listings; delistings; symbol/name changes; dividends
historical_availability: Historical access subject to product agreement
commercial_redistribution: Contracted feed; confirm downstream redistribution and corporate-action entitlements.
coverage_gaps: Not a free open-data source; global corporate actions need more exchanges/vendors.

name: SEC EDGAR Company Facts and submissions
coverage: US SEC reporting issuers, including qualifying foreign filers
fields: CIK; entity name; taxonomy/tag; unit; value; period start/end; form; accession; filed date; fiscal year/period
extraction_method: JSON REST; nightly bulk files for scale
update_frequency: As filings are processed; bulk nightly
historical_availability: XBRL coverage commonly from 2009; varies by issuer and concept
authentication: No API key; identify automated user agent and follow SEC fair access
extraction_outcome: Docs reviewed; exploratory Apple endpoint returned HTTP 200, but no archived B pipeline is included
commercial_redistribution: SEC states public filings and government-created content are reusable. Keep provenance; check separately licensed identifiers/third-party material.
coverage_gaps: Not standardized global financial statements. Restatements, extension tags and fiscal calendars require mapping; ratios are derived.

name: SEC 13F and insider ownership filings
fields: 13F manager/holding/share count/value/report period; Forms 3/4/5 owner/transaction date/shares/price/code
update_frequency: Filing/event-driven; 13F holdings lag the report date
historical_availability: EDGAR archive depth varies; structured format availability varies
authentication: No API key; descriptive User-Agent; at most 10 requests/sec across machines
extraction_outcome: Documentation reviewed; no filing extraction implemented
commercial_redistribution: Filing content reusable per SEC policy; licensed identifiers need separate assessment. Do not infer holdings freshness from download time.
coverage_gaps: 13F does not represent every institution or position; filing corrections must be retained.

name: SEC Form N-PORT data sets
coverage: Covered US registered funds, including ETFs; not ETF-only
fields: Fund/series identifiers; reporting period; portfolio securities; values; exposures; available reported fund metrics
extraction_method: Quarterly ZIP files of tabular structured data; filing XML alternative
update_frequency: Quarterly bulk publication of public filing information
authentication: No API key; SEC fair-access rules
extraction_outcome: Official archive reviewed; large ZIPs not downloaded
commercial_redistribution: SEC reuse policy applies to filing content; assess proprietary identifiers separately.
coverage_gaps: Not daily holdings, daily NAV, global ETF master or market prices. Identify ETFs and honor filing/release lag.

name: Alpha Vantage ETF profile and holdings
fields: ETF profile; expense ratio; assets; holdings; sector allocations; related price endpoints
update_frequency: Provider-dependent; holdings as-of dates must be inspected
commercial_redistribution: Commercial redistribution requires written agreement; not assumed from public API access.
coverage_gaps: Premium/discount requires matching-date NAV and exchange close; split/currency alignment needed.

name: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates
coverage: EUR against published currencies; additions/removals over time
fields: Observation date; quoted currency; units of quoted currency per EUR
extraction_method: XML file; normalized into daily observations
update_frequency: Working days, normally around 16:00 CET, excluding TARGET closures
historical_availability: EUR reference history since 1999; varies by currency
extraction_outcome: HTTP 200 archived; working pipeline and normalized samples included
commercial_redistribution: Reuse subject to ECB attribution, accurate presentation, marking modifications and informing paying users that original information is freely available. Information rates, not execution quotes.
coverage_gaps: No intraday OHLCV, executable spread or exchange holiday API. Cross-rates are derived.

name: Coinbase Exchange public market data
coverage: Products traded on Coinbase Exchange only
fields: Product/base/quote; trades; prices; volume; order book; timestamped candles
historical_availability: Product and endpoint dependent; historical candles require bounded windows
authentication: Public market endpoints do not require trading authentication
commercial_redistribution: Current market-data terms prohibit external redistribution and derived works without prior express written consent.
coverage_gaps: No universal crypto price or global supply/market cap; venue and geographic availability vary.

name: CoinGecko market aggregates
coverage: Provider-tracked global crypto assets and venues
fields: Asset ID; price; market cap; volume; exchange/ticker reference; historical market series
extraction_outcome: Official API and terms pages reviewed; no keyed extraction
commercial_redistribution: Incorporating data in a product differs from reselling API access. Redistribution/syndication requires an executed agreement.
coverage_gaps: Market cap depends on supply methodology; retain provider-specific methodology and timestamps.

name: EIA Open Data
coverage: US and selected international energy data
fields: Period; product/process/area dimensions; price or volume; units; series metadata
extraction_method: API v2 JSON; some bulk files
historical_availability: Series-specific; inspect route metadata for start/end
extraction_outcome: Official API, copyright and service terms reviewed; no key used
commercial_redistribution: EIA describes government publications as public domain; check series for non-government content and comply with API terms.
coverage_gaps: Energy series only; no complete metals/agriculture/futures contracts universe.

name: World Bank Pink Sheet
coverage: Global benchmark energy, metals and agricultural commodity series
fields: Commodity; month/year; average benchmark price; unit
historical_availability: Long monthly/annual history; exact start varies by series and workbook
extraction_outcome: Official download page reviewed; workbook not extracted
commercial_redistribution: World Bank dataset licence and any third-party exceptions must be checked at series level; preserve attribution.
coverage_gaps: Monthly benchmark averages are not exchange spot ticks or tradable futures settlements.

name: US Treasury daily par yield curves
coverage: US sovereign nominal par curve maturities
fields: NEW_DATE; BC_nMONTH; BC_nYEAR; value in annual percent; missing maturity values
extraction_method: XML by year/month; all-history feed paginated
historical_availability: Nominal par curve since 1990; individual tenors start later
extraction_outcome: 2024 and 2025 XML returned HTTP 200; pipeline and archives included
commercial_redistribution: Government-origin series is a relatively low-friction candidate; this project has not established a blanket worldwide redistribution licence. Confirm source-specific and jurisdictional rights before launch; no official endorsement.
coverage_gaps: A fitted par curve, not security prices, a zero curve, bond total returns, coupons or credit ratings.

name: Fiscal Data average Treasury interest rates
extraction_outcome: Small exploratory API request returned HTTP 200; not part of the packaged three-pipeline evidence
commercial_redistribution: Government-origin candidate; confirm exact dataset reuse terms and geographic scope before redistribution.
coverage_gaps: Average interest cost by category is not a market yield or individual bond coupon.

name: S&P Dow Jones Indices licensing
coverage: Provider equity, sector, fixed-income and commodity index families
fields: Contracted index values/returns; constituents/weights and reference metadata according to entitlement
extraction_method: Licensed data service; public pages for discovery only
extraction_outcome: Official licensing page reviewed; no index data downloaded
commercial_redistribution: Explicit index/data licence required; publicly visible values are not permission to sell an index API.
coverage_gaps: No verified open global constituent/weight source; benchmark branding and use rights differ.

name: World Bank Indicators API / WDI
coverage: World economies; prototype uses IND/USA/GBR GDP growth
fields: Indicator ID; country ISO3; year; value; unit/metadata; source update date
update_frequency: GDP annual observation frequency; releases/revisions follow source updates, not daily price ticks
historical_availability: Many indicators span 50+ years; varies by country/indicator
extraction_outcome: Real GDP-growth request returned HTTP 200; pipeline preserves source bytes and generates samples
commercial_redistribution: WDI GDP-growth metadata identifies CC BY 4.0; attribute and mark normalization. Check metadata/licence for each additional indicator.
coverage_gaps: Prototype implements one indicator only. Inflation, unemployment, reserves, industrial production and calendars need additional sources/adapters.

name: FRED and ALFRED
coverage: US and international economic series from many underlying publishers
fields: Series ID; date; value; frequency; units; seasonal adjustment; vintage dates where available
extraction_outcome: Official API terms reviewed; no API extraction
commercial_redistribution: Rights vary by underlying series. Check copyright notes; a FRED key does not grant redistribution rights to every series.
coverage_gaps: Source-level attribution, vintage semantics and calendar release times require explicit mapping.

name: Computed analytics / TA-Lib candidate
coverage: Only the assets/series for which licensed inputs are available
fields: RSI; MACD; moving averages; returns; volatility; drawdown; correlation; benchmark-relative performance
extraction_method: Compute locally from validated input series; TA-Lib optional, not installed or used in this prototype
historical_availability: Limited by clean input history and indicator warm-up period
authentication: No source API key for local computations
extraction_outcome: Library documentation reviewed; requested investment analytics not implemented; FX conversion demo included separately
commercial_redistribution: TA-Lib software has BSD licensing; software permission does not grant market-data or derived-output redistribution rights.
coverage_gaps: Define adjusted/total-return input, return convention, calendar, warm-up, ddof and minimum overlap; no forward filling across missing prices by default.
